## Why This Is Asked

- ViewModel + SavedStateHandle
- Window size classes / configuration

```kotlin
data class Note(val id: String, val title: String, val body: String)

class NotesViewModel(savedStateHandle: SavedStateHandle) : ViewModel() {

    Note("1", "First", "Hello"),
    Note("2", "Second", "World")

}
```

- RecyclerView + Adapter
- JSON parsing (kotlinx.serialization)

```kotlin
@Serializable
data class Item(val name: String, val code: String)

suspend fun loadItems(ctx: Context): List<Item> {
  val json = ctx.assets.open(\"items.json\").bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
  return Json.decodeFromString<List<Item>>(json)
}
```

## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design a robust offline-first media feature with encryption, search indexing, and cross-device sync. Evaluates trade-offs between user privacy, performance, and reliability in real-world conditions.

## Key Concepts

- Android Keystore AES-GCM encryption for transcripts
- Room + SQLite FTS5 for fast transcript search
- WorkManager for background prefetch and refresh
- Resumable, chunked downloads for large audio files
- CRDT tombstones for cross-device listened-state synchronization

## Code Example

```kotlin
data class Episode(val id: String, val title: String, val audioPath: String, val transcriptId: String)

@Entity(tableName = "transcripts")
data class TranscriptSegment(
  @PrimaryKey val id: String,
  val episodeId: String,
  val startMs: Long,
  val endMs: Long,
  val text: String
)
```

```kotlin
@Dao
interface TranscriptDao {
  @Query("SELECT * FROM transcripts WHERE episodeId = :episodeId ORDER BY startMs")
  fun getSegments(episodeId: String): List<TranscriptSegment>

  @Query("SELECT * FROM transcripts WHERE transcript MATCH :query")
  fun search(query: String): List<TranscriptSegment>
}
```

- How would you handle partial transcript encryption when offline? 
- What eviction policy would you apply for transcripts vs. audio?
- How would you test CRDT tombstone convergence across flaky networks?

## Code Example
```kotlin
// Kotlin sketch: encrypt deltas with Android Keystore
fun encryptDeltas(deltas: ByteArray, keyAlias: String): ByteArray {
  val ks = KeyStore.getInstance("AndroidKeyStore").apply { load(null) }
  val cert = ks.getCertificate(keyAlias) ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("No key")
  val public = cert.publicKey
  val cipher = Cipher.getInstance("RSA/ECB/PKCS1Padding")
  cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, public)
  return cipher.doFinal(deltas)
}
```

```kotlin
// Example: signature verification skeleton
fun verifySignature(data: ByteArray, signature: ByteArray, publicKey: PublicKey): Boolean {
  val sig = Signature.getInstance("SHA256withRSA")
  sig.initVerify(publicKey)
  sig.update(data)
  return sig.verify(signature)
}
```
